body.heading: Where in the world is Namibia?
paragraphs: Namibia is a country in Southern Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Namibia is Windhoek.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Namibia speak English and Afrikaans.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Namibia is the Namibian dollar.

body.heading: How big is Namibia?
paragraphs: Namibia covers about 826,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about three times the size of Burkina Faso.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Some of the tallest sand dunes on Earth glow red-orange at Sossusvlei. Climbing Dune 45 at sunrise and seeing the white clay pan of Deadvlei is unforgettable.
Etosha circles a salt pan so big it can be seen from space. At its waterholes, rhinos, lions, elephants and springbok gather, especially in the dry season.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Namibia on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
